# Raven Nexus Home Setup

Capability ID: raven-nexus-home-setup-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/raven-nexus
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- organize my household accounts documents and important information
- my family information is scattered across too many apps
- set up a safe AI-ready home information system
- create a family continuity and account-access map
- organize household documents and recurring obligations
- help my family know where important information lives
- Raven Nexus Home

## Problem

A household has important documents, recurring obligations, account information and family logistics scattered across apps and people, and needs a permission-aware continuity and organization layer without giving AI uncontrolled authority.

## Inputs

Household goals and only the accounts, documents or categories the customer explicitly chooses to inventory. Public discovery never requests passwords, security answers, private financial records or precise location.

## Outputs

Household information inventory, continuity map, permission/access plan, AI-context plan, bounded Raven Nexus Home configuration and handoff guidance.

## Pricing

Home Stability Map $199 one-time; Connected Home Setup $499 one-time.

- Raven Nexus Home Stability Map: $199 (one_time)

- Raven Nexus Connected Home Setup: $499 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

SELL-NOW HUMAN HANDOFF: the $199 Home Stability Map is the smallest paid entry. Discovery is public and read-only; any private access or implementation remains explicitly human-authorized.

Agents may explain the offer and route a human to Evercraft for review. Discovery creates no access or payment obligation. Any account/document access or connection requires explicit authorization. Raven Home does not claim bank-side transaction control, emergency response, covert tracking or unrestricted device access.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; human-confirmed handoff only until a product-specific direct checkout is independently verified. Paid state requires authoritative provider verification.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
